title: spec + lint 18.x: refuse an action's copy-template findings (blank text, an unbound root, a ${…} or single-brace token) at validate / compile / the publish gate — the refusal half of #24814 (ruling 6365736632)
body:
Filing gate **③, a follow-up owed by landing work**: the refusal half of ruling `6365736632` on #24814, which orders this card filed when #24814 lands. #24814 landed with PR #25637 (`384bb7ba02`). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post #18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's; the bulk analogue #25205 was graded p1.

## Why it is a separate card

Ruling `6365736632`, verbatim: "**The refusal half** (blank and door findings as errors) is its own BREAKING minor card, filed when this card lands, as #25205 is for the bulk slot."

PR #25637 typed the 9 page action-row slots (`confirmText`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage` on `ActionButtonProps`, `ActionIconProps` and the action-container member shape) and `ActionSchema.confirmText` / `successMessage` as `template` slots. It ships them **widening only**, as the module itself records (`packages/spec/src/ui/action-copy-template.ts` about `:40`–`:46`): "Both still parse: the slot keeps a blank-string arm, and the doors' findings are WARNINGS — an advisory at the publish gate, never a refusal. Refusing them is a narrowing no ADR-0087 conversion carries, so it is its own card." Every such sentence parsed while these keys were `z.string()` / `I18nLabel`, so refusing it is a narrowing. Under the amended 「甲」 it ships in 18.x as its own BREAKING minor, as #25205 did for the bulk slot.

## Scope (for triage)

- In `packages/lint/src/validate-action-copy-templates.ts`, promote the findings `judgeAction` emits (about `:118`, `severity: 'warning'` with the `ADVISORY` suffix) from `warning` to `error` at all three doors: `os validate`, `compile`, and the publish gate, which then answers its 422. The findings are a blank sentence, a hole over a root the key does not bind, a single-brace `{x}` token, and a `${…}` token, where the judge already prescribes the `{{ }}` hole.
- Decide the blank-string arm in `actionCopyTemplateSlot` (`action-copy-template.ts` about `:146`, `z.string().regex(/^\s*$/)`): refuse it as other template slots do, or keep it. Say which and why. #25205's answer for the bulk slot is the precedent to read first.
- The `${…}` transition: the console runner still fills `${…}` in a sentence with no `{{ }}` hole (the same module's "The `${…}` spelling" note). Refusing `${…}` at the doors ends that transition on the authoring side; check objectui's runner is ready for it, or keep `${…}` a warning and say so.
- Changeset: BREAKING minor (FROM warning, save succeeds → TO refused), `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, and the ADR-0087 disposition.
- Measure producers first. PR #25637 converted the 4 `platform-objects` sentences and the 9 in `plugin-approvals`. Re-measure `examples/**` (files that carry these keys today include `app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts`, `app-showcase/src/ui/views/project.view.ts`, `app-todo/src/actions/task.actions.ts`, `app-crm/src/flows/convert-lead.flow.ts`) and HotCRM's action sentences against the judge.

**Order:** after PR #25637 (merged). `ActionSchema.errorMessage` and `outcomeMessages` stay outside the family (the contract review `6385469184` on PR #25637, open question 1), so they are not in this card.

## Dedupe

Parent: #24814 (closed by PR #25637). Semantic issue search "refuse action confirmText successMessage errorMessage template warning to error narrowing": 1 hit, #24814 itself. Control query "bulk confirmText refusal unbound root single-brace token publish gate": 2 hits, including #25205, the bulk analogue. **New.**
